# Proof Physical Therapy
> Independent outpatient physical therapy clinic headquartered at 44056 Mound Rd, Suite 103, Sterling Heights, Michigan — opening February 2027. Tagline: "Recovery, proven." Serves Macomb and Oakland County communities.

## Key facts
- The differentiator: objective computerized range-of-motion and strength testing at evaluation and discharge — recovery measured in numbers, reported to physicians, adjusters and attorneys automatically
- Flagship specialty: car accident (Michigan auto no-fault/PIP) injury rehab — claim verification before visit one, no visit cap under Michigan no-fault, typically $0 patient cost for accident care
- 17 condition programs: back, neck/whiplash, sciatica, herniated disc, knee, hip, shoulder, foot/ankle, elbow/wrist/hand, headaches, dizziness/vertigo (BPPV), arthritis, chronic pain, post-surgical, sports, work injuries
- Programs: recovery & wellness memberships, balance/fall prevention, Medicare maintenance (Jimmo) program, return-to-play testing; service lines for physicians, attorneys, employers (FCE/POET/ergonomics)
- Michigan direct access: start PT without referral (10 visits/21 days before prescription needed; wellness exempt)
- Insurance: Medicare, Medicare Advantage, BCBSM/BCN, Priority Health, HAP, Aetna, Cigna, UnitedHealthcare, Michigan Medicaid HMOs, all auto no-fault carriers, workers' compensation
- Standards: evaluations within 2-3 business days; 40-55 minute treatment visits; one primary therapist
